authority: User requested Shop-Only Economy Rework v2; original acceptance IDs and evidence gates retained.

changes.before: Inspect actual workspace/Git, preserve owner work and record the newest strictly1v1/no-earned-meter scope.
changes.after: Inspect actual workspace/Git, preserve owner work and record the newest strictly 1v1 shop-only bank scope with nonspendable next-shop skill receipts.

changes.before: Full canonical snapshot/restore includes input buffers, action/parry state, wallets, floors and spend receipts.
changes.after: Full canonical snapshot/restore includes input buffers, action/parry state, frozen bank, round capabilities, super-use receipts, root provenance, eligible-defense clocks and bounded skill ledger.

changes.before: Negative-edge free specials, same-tick EX chords, throw/overhead chords and paid-command priority are tested.
changes.after: Negative-edge free specials, same-tick EX chords, throw/overhead chords and capability-command priority are tested without illegal fallback.

changes.before: Damage scaling, chip/KO, stun/dizzy and juggle budgets enforce their data without resource income.
changes.after: Damage scaling, chip/KO, stun/dizzy and juggle budgets enforce their data. Damage does not automatically grant currency; typed skill contacts follow the bounded v2 contract.

changes.before: Multihit parries require distinct arms and contacts; successful parry prevents damage/chip/stun without credit reward.
changes.after: Multihit parries require distinct arms and contacts. Parry prevents damage/chip/stun; only eligible fresh manual precision parries grant bounded next-shop receipts once per original attack root.

changes.before: Exactly one scalar wallet per player; no earned meter, paid-use inventory, team/provenance balances or combat/time income.
changes.after: Exactly one shop-only bank per player, frozen throughout Fight; nonspendable pending skill receipts and round capabilities cannot authorize currency spending in combat.

changes.before: Legal EX/selected-super startup atomically debits once; whiff/block/parry/interruption do not refund.
changes.after: An owned EX family is repeatable for the round at zero activation cost; a prepaid super consumes its sole use on legal startup, with no whiff/block/parry/interruption refund.

changes.before: Illegal/unaffordable/reserve-denied/unselected/negative-edge paid commands never debit or trigger fallback/delayed actions.
changes.after: Unowned, exhausted, illegal or merely buffered capability commands never consume a super use, debit bank, or trigger an unintended free fallback.

changes.before: Optional reserve is only a same-wallet minimum; locked round floor cannot be altered via combat messages.
changes.after: Saved bank is protected throughout Fight. Mixed carts have a 2400-credit limit and explicit slot caps; nonzero legacy reserve-floor requests are rejected.

changes.before: Rollback restores wallet and receipts together; disappearing/repeated/changed paid inputs give canonical balances.
changes.after: Rollback restores capabilities, super uses, provenance, skill receipts and pending rewards together; disappearing, repeated or changed inputs give canonical state and frozen bank.

changes.before: Actual C# payouts/caps/tier progression and savings examples conform to independent fixtures.
changes.after: Actual C# v2 payouts (win1200, draw900, loss1200/1200/1500), cap3600, tier progression and outcome-first skill settlement clipping conform to independent fixtures.

changes.before: Optional three-slot leases validate fighter/slot/price; editing draft is not an irreversible purchase.
changes.after: Optional mixed carts validate fighter, implementation, unique IDs, replacements, price and limits (1signature, 1technique, 1gambit, 2EX, 1super); editing a draft is reversible.

changes.before: The core trial has 12 rentals and six established supers; the expanded trial has 24 rentals and six supers including Overtime and Prism Lattice. All have explicit availability, effects and one-wallet prices.
changes.after: Core catalog provides 12 rentals, 8 EX licenses and 6 super permits; the expanded catalog provides 24 rentals, 8 EX licenses and 6 permits, all with legal entrypoints and counterplay.

changes.before: Player-readable round economy summary and machine-readable confirmed spend/result logs agree with actual replay.
changes.after: Replays retain confirmed cart, super-use and skill-reward receipts; verification reproduces exact commands, typed events, bank and canonical hashes.

changes.before: In-combat wallet/floor/receipt restoration survives rollback around both EX and super startups.
changes.after: Late input correction restores capabilities, super-use state, pending skill rewards and confirmed event presentation without duplicate receipts.

changes.before: Late parry changing paid-super KO prevents speculative payout and invalidates corrected audiovisual terminal effects.
changes.after: A predicted prepaid-super use, reward and terminal result can disappear on correction; only the confirmed canonical result and receipts are published.

changes.before: HUD shows a single wallet, costs/floor/leases/affordability and subtle debit rejection, not earned gauge.
changes.after: Fight HUD shows static saved bank, owned EX families, super NONE/READY/USED and nonspendable NEXT SHOP rewards; shop explains prices, cart limits and remaining bank.

changes.before: Counterbalanced budget/matchup/seat/art experiments record raw full-match outcomes and uncertainty, not teammate metrics.
changes.after: Matched v2 pilots compare product purchase versus saving, score0-0 and score1-0 openings with equal banks, and shop-only A/B/C/D payouts crossed with rewards on/off, reporting samples and uncertainty.

changes.before: Zero-credit/full-wallet tests probe EX loops, chip, parry, corner and optional lease dominance.
changes.after: Zero-bank/full-bank and low-health corner probes exercise repeatable EX pressure, chip, manual parry, movement and product interactions, reporting tactical failures honestly.

changes.before: Recovery-farming, cap, final-round all-in and spending-policy tests distinguish intended incentives from exploits.
changes.after: Matched spending and reward-seeking policies probe caps, recovery incentives and full-match outcomes; limited bots are distinguished from exhaustive anti-farming or competitive-balance proof.

changes.before: Two physical machines complete a private1v1 LAN match with matching confirmed result and debit logs.
changes.after: Two physical machines complete a private 1v1 LAN match with matching confirmed result, cart, super-use and skill-reward logs.
